entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2100442009379544320: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.2804 +/- 0.3995 mas (same row, RUWE 16.36): 438.52 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -8.167, -16.525 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2100442009379544320 (quality A), from 2022ApJS..259...35A; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.688 +/- 0.048 solar radii from Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-1795 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html). Mass 0.768 +/- 0.024 solar masses from Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-1795 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html). Temperature 4500 +/- 123 K from Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-1795 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,500 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffdebc. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,500 K and log g 4.65 (u1 0.774, u2 0.021): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
